topics.label: Ask about her job
topics.player: What do you do for work?
topics.replyDefault: I'm a {job}. Some days it's great, other days I'm just trying to get through my inbox!

replyByFaction.thunderbirds: I'm a {job}. The charity events are glamorous, but there's always something going on behind the scenes.
replyByFaction.police: I'm a {job}. The hours are strange and I can't share much about what happens at work.
replyByFaction.progressives: I'm a {job}. My workplace is very invested in changing the world. Sometimes a little too invested.
replyByFaction.sisters_of_mercy: I'm a {job}. My parish community takes up a lot of my time, and I'm happy to help.
replyByFaction.fourth_estate: I'm a {job}. The city produces more stories than our little newsroom can follow.
replyByFaction.goth_girls: I'm a {job}. The night shift is when the interesting people come out.

topics.label: Ask what she does on her days off
topics.player: What do you do on your days off?
topics.replyDefault: A bit of everything. Coffee, bad films and seeing my friends. Sometimes I just want a quiet day.

replyByFaction.sisters_of_mercy: I spend my free days with the chapel community. The quiet and tradition mean a lot to us.
replyByFaction.goth_girls: I go out late. There are a few basement venues that never advertise.
replyByFaction.thunderbirds: Brunch, sometimes fundraisers. I seem to live in a permanent event calendar.

topics.label: Ask about her friends
topics.player: Who do you usually hang out with?
topics.replyDefault: A pretty mixed group. Some are sensible and a few are absolutely impossible.

replyByFaction.police: A lot of people from work, though some of us disagree about how things ought to be done.
replyByFaction.progressives: Mostly campus friends and organizers. Every conversation turns into a debate.
replyByFaction.fourth_estate: Journalists, mostly. We know far too much gossip about everyone.
replyByFaction.goth_girls: You wouldn't know them. At least, I hope you wouldn't.

topics.label: Ask about the Blue Ribbon mystery
topics.player: Did you hear about the Blue Ribbon gala and Elena Cross? Something seems wrong.
topics.replyDefault: I saw a headline about it. It's a small city when something unusual happens.

replyByFaction.thunderbirds: I know people who worked on the event. There was an argument about who Elena was meeting afterwards. I would rather not name anyone over text.
replyByFaction.police: The police are already checking the reports. I really can't say more than the public appeal.
